title: Tool-Use Capability x Containment Gaps: Compounding Irreversibility

original_idea.body: Build a sandboxed agent with a configurable reversible/irreversible toolset, hold the monitor fixed, and measure expected irreversible-harm per missed flag as the toolset grows.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Maps containment value vs action-space irreversibility, operationalizing a named runtime-control problem.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Sandbox agent with configurable mock tools; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused curve but a configurable sandbox is a non-trivial dependency.

low_compute.reasoning: Mock tools, light inference, no training.

novelty.reasoning: Irreversibility/containment discussed; the explicit curve may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Containment discussed; the quantitative irreversibility curve may be open.
